lines: Rulebook v28y (in force since 2026-10-25): nothing has earned a place yet, so it waits.
Scanner paper books: 26 setups, 468 closed trades; random entries -0.04R a trade. None beats random at the unlucky end of its range (most lose to it on average), so none is in the rulebook.
Runner backtest: no forward book yet (it needs the backtest to run again), so nothing from it is in the rulebook.
Bottomed-out backtest: nothing held on both halves (best "dca / riskoff" +8.5%, older +16.6%, newer -7.1%), so no DCA in the rulebook.
Pattern backtest: no exit made money over 30+ signals (-0.47R a trade as traded), so no chart patterns in the rulebook.
Bots: 20 books, 136 closed trades read (retired bots included); a way losing on both halves over 30+ live trades is kept out of the rulebook.

filters: No pools a dev can pull: coins not launched on pump.fun rugged 41% of the time against 12% (first day's 650 trench trades)
No painted charts: wash volume (the hour's trading many times the coin's value) and one-way buying (buys with almost no sells) are never bought
No broken quotes: liquidity bigger than the coin, prices against the wrong token, or a pool that grew faster than its price allows are ignored
No chasing: nothing more than 10% past its signal price (chasing a +30% five minutes lost money in every trench way)
Real exits only: every sale capped by what the pool can pay, dead pools and coins nobody can sell booked at zero
